# ![](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)Outline editor. *The writing surface for clear thinking.*

Feels like writing. Works like a knowledge graph. Start simple, end with
a system that connects everything you know. Feather-light yet packed
with power.

## Start writing, structure follows

The outline in Tana Outliner lets you start immediately without setup.
Structure emerges naturally. No designing schemas upfront, no choosing
between notes and databases.

The outline gives you both freeform writing and structured data at once.

Feels *simple*. Builds a [*knowledge graph*](/knowledge-graph).

## See the big picture while keeping the details

The outline's infinite zoom controls what you see. Zoom in to focus on
one item and everything else disappears. Zoom out to see how it all
connects.

When you have 200 notes, you can see one or see them all. The details
are always there when you need them.

Zoom in to *focus*. Zoom out for *context*.

## Structure information in a flash

The outline makes shaping information effortless. Move items to explore
how ideas relate. Indent to nest, outdent to separate. Create
relationships instantly.

Stop duplicating information, start reusing knowledge. Information can
grow in multiple places at once. Update it anywhere and it updates
everywhere. No rigid folders, no duplicate information to keep in sync.

A tool that helps you *think*.

> “Tana Outliner operates in the sweet spot of outliners and databases,
> creating a new kind of flexibility that sometimes resembles magic.”

## A flexible foundation for real knowledge work

The outline editor is the writing surface, but its real power is what
you can build on top of it. Whether you are managing a team, running a
company, learning a new field, or shipping software, the outline scales
with how you actually think.

## Way beyond a simple outline

**Supertags, one \# away.** Add structure to any information with
[Supertags](/supertags). Fields appear inline as you write. Turn
thinking into structured knowledge without breaking the flow of writing.

**Inline AI anywhere.** Press space for [AI](/ai) help anywhere in your
outline. It assists you directly where you are working, not in a
separate chat window. Your AI can join part of your outline immediately.

**One source, many views.** Switch any outline to a [table, cards, or
calendar](/views) instantly. Same information, different perspectives.
Work however makes sense for what you are doing right now.

## Work the way you think

No setup. Just start writing.
